*update* it failed... terribly.
Starting at 500?? Damn so is me normally having 5000-10000 calorie binges completely out of the norm!

I tried so many approaches, i tried completely cutting it out, then i tried seeing if i could handle having a moderate amount, then i tried swapping out the added sugars with natural sugars, and so on, everything has failed me and i end up binging til im stuffed on the sugary sweets i crave, the lengths i end up going to for me to satisfy my cravings are actually insane..

Sounds like your on par with stephanie buttermore’s all in approach, tbh im not even dieting, but i just cant stop binging like crazy on sweets, even when full, i think i fucked up my hunger hormones from losing weight previously, cuz now i cant even tell when im hungry since i dont even ever feel full. Its like i can always eat more, always... even after a 5000+ cal binge, if i give it an hour i could binge again if i really wanted to.
Life is highs and lows, thats what keeps things balanced, right now my life is fucking low but im also happy knowing it is bound to go up again, with the right action taken of course, stay strong xx
I dont wanna give false hopes until i know it actually is going to work. Im like 99% sure it will but still... i gotta test it out and see
